title: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Graph Systems
description: Back to jobs New Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Graph Systems United States Apply About Us: Inca Digital is a veteran-owned data and intelligence company specializing in digital-asset analytics for exchanges, financial institutions, regulators, and blockchain ecosystems. Our technology and expertise provide clarity across crypto markets, tracking blockchain transactions, liquidity movements, and illicit finance, helping clients identify risk, enhance transparency, and improve decision-making. Inca’s infrastructure fuses structured and unstructured data from blockchains, exchanges, social networks, and financial markets. The result is a powerful analytics engine that supports ecosystem monitoring, market surveillance, and counter–illicit finance intelligence across digital-asset networks. Inca operates as a fast-paced, nimble, global, and remote technology company. We leverage an asynchronous‑first workflow, try to minimize time spent on meetings, and believe in open debate and logic over authority. Work alongside some of the sharpest minds in the world, including intelligence analysts, defense veterans, data engineers, quant researchers, linguists, and more. Role Overview: As a Software Engineer on our Research & Development Team, you will help design, build, and scale new data products, infrastructure, and investigative tools from the ground up. Reporting directly to the Head of R&D, you will play a central role in system integration, feature design, and product prioritization while taking direct ownership of core engineering initiatives. The R&D team is the engine behind Inca’s intelligence platform. We consume, process, store, and analyze massive streams of internal and external data, transforming complex, interconnected datasets into actionable, production-grade APIs, graph analytics, interactive dashboards, and real-time alert systems used directly by our clients. What You'll Own Design, build, and operate end-to-end data infrastructure and solutions for delivering APIs, custom containerized applications, automated alerting/reporting, and graph-based visualizations to federal and commercial clients. Model and deploy relational, document, and graph databases for supporting investigative workflows and large-scale network analysis. Build resilient ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, normalize, and reconcile structured and semi-structured data from internal databases, REST APIs, blockchain nodes, and third-party feeds. Own data quality, lineage, and reproducibility. Our outputs support enforcement actions and litigation, so provenance is a product requirement, not a nice-to-have. Automate orchestration, systems integration, and deployment through CI/CD (GitHub Actions) into AWS cloud environments. Partner with the Head of R&D, data scientists, and our specialized investigations teams to translate intelligence requirements into production software. Make and document architecture decisions, evaluate new technology, and cut through genuinely ambiguous problems spanning crypto, finance, and national security. What We Require You must be able to pass a U.S. Tier 3 background investigation, which under federal rules is generally limited to U.S. citizens. Proficient in Python. Proven experience designing and operating production data infrastructure and pipelines — systems you were responsible for when they broke, not only contributed to. Deep PostgreSQL experience (self-managed or RDS/Aurora), including schema design and query optimization. Graph data modeling and network analysis experience. Neo4j and Cypher preferred; Neptune or a comparable graph database is fine. Comprehensive grasp of architectural trade-offs when deploying graph-based systems, including specific performance advantages and technical limitations. Production experience deploying and configuring containerized services to AWS. Nice to Have Infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform). Go as an additional language. An active TS/SCI. We sponsor investigations for candidates without one, and you can begin work before adjudication completes. Message queues and event-driven data pipelines (SQS/SNS, Kafka), and search or document stores (OpenSearch, MongoDB). Familiarity with blockchain ledger data, smart contracts, or blockchain analytics. You will ramp meaningfully faster with it, and we weigh this heavily. NLP techniques, LLM integration, or building and evaluating ML models. Background in financial services or trading venues, or familiarity with SEC, CFTC, or FinCEN regulatory frameworks. Experience operating in FedRAMP, AWS GovCloud, or NIST 800-171 environments. Why join us? We operate in a fully remote, high-trust environment and prioritize impact and delivered results over hours logged. We offer competitive compensation and healthcare stipend. We invest in our people through childcare stipends and dedicated employee assistance resources. Join a thought leader at the intersection of national security and digital assets, working with cutting-edge tech that defines the field. Curious about how we build at Inca Digital? Hear directly from our Head of R&D on how our team builds the infrastructure that powers Inca's intelligence, merging financial, natural language, and blockchain data into custom dashboards and automation tools built around each client's needs. 🎥 Watch on YouTube: Inside Inca | The Engine Behind Inca's Intelligence Inclusion & Equal Opportunity: As a veteran-owned company, Inca Digital thrives on diverse perspectives, specifically across race, gender, neurodivergence, and veteran status, to solve complex data challenges. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to protected status, including disability or national origin.
